published_prior_art.cite: LiangRecht2025 fixes independent Rademacher assignment for its quadratic-chaos estimator; GuoLiang2026 optimizes a different OLS criterion within a Markov subclass.
GuoLiang2026 proves asymptotic iid optimality only for its robust E-optimal OLS objective and random-switch class, not this exact fixed-path-MSE threshold.
GuoLiang2026 defines the stationary homogeneous random-switch subclass but does not compare it with the all pairwise-orthogonal-law class.
Golay1961 and DavisJedwab1999 establish complementary deterministic code constructions; no verified source gives this one-path randomized stationary minimax-MSE lift.

BandeiraKunisky2018 treats degree-four pseudomoments rather than the proposed genuine temporal binary-law projection; Manchester2010 gives a relaxation rather than a necessary-and-sufficient realization criterion.

novelty_flags.label: related_work, literature_checklist, comparator_promise_table: ThiyageswaranEtAl2026
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited arXiv v1 places the fourth-order Gaussian/Isserlis calculation in Appendix F.3 on p. 32, immediately after Example 10, not on pp. 55–56 before Example 12; Example 10 is the linear-interference example, not the claimed p. 53 heterogeneous-variation example.

novelty_flags.one_line: Definition 3.6 defines the asymptotic OLS design objective; the stationary homogeneous random-switch subclass is Definition 4.1, so the comparison must correct its locator and description.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:lag-one-minimax and thm:stationary-golay-optimum
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Optimality ranges over assignment laws for the displayed unbiased moment estimator only, not over all estimators or analyses of the path.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact/minimax optimality conditional on use of the specified moment estimator and the stated fixed-path ellipsoid.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 5–6, Section 2.3, equation (6) and immediately following display
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines its method-of-moments estimator, explicitly treats it as quadratic chaos in independent Rademacher variables, and derives its unbiasedness under independent randomization.

Definition 3.6 is the asymptotic objective wᵀ(EΣ)⁻¹w; Definition 4.1, not Definition 3.6, defines stationary homogeneous random-switch designs; Theorem 4.6 sends robust-design minimizers to (1/2,1/2).

source_verification_receipts.locator: Appendix F.3, pp. 31–32, Example 10 and following paragraph
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Example 10 derives a Rademacher objective proportional to (xᵀLx)²; the following paragraph relaxes x to Gaussian and gives E[(xᵀLx)²]=Tr(LX)²+2Tr((LX)²) by Isserlis.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct the two mislocated prior-work descriptions everywhere, preserving the verified substantive distinction: Guo--Liang's Definition 4.1 random-switch class and Thiyageswaran et al.'s Appendix F.3 Example 10 Gaussian relaxation.

Give an independently defensible calibration protocol for the joint coefficient--disturbance ellipsoid, or add the separate-radius adversary as a robustness corollary to show which parity and iid-threshold conclusions survive without coupling signal strength to deterministic drift.

Promote the general lag-four OEQ by specifying a first nontrivial finite (T,K,q) target and a candidate parity/positivity facet or orbit-recovery algorithm, so it becomes a falsifiable finite-horizon frontier rather than only a broad characterization program.

recommended_next_step: Correct the two verified citation mischaracterizations, retain the estimator-scoped minimax headline, and advance the repaired field-tier proposal to Stage 0.
